---
title: "SCFA report - `r params$project_id`"
author: "Microbiome Insights"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%d %B, %Y')`"
params:
  project_id: "P-00UH"
  sample_type: "Plasma"
  scfa_dir: "chromatograms"
  manifest_path: "P-00UH_manifest.xlsx"
  analytes: !expr scfaReporter::default_scfa_analytes()
  normalization_multiplier: 7
  normalization_basis: "mmol_per_L_plasma"
  stats: "lmer"   # options: lmer, anova, none
  lmer_formula: !expr value ~ Group * Time + (1 | Subject_ID)
  aov_formula: !expr NULL
  x_col: "Group"
  facet_col: "Time"
  y_label: "mmol SCFA / L plasma"
  export_csv: true
format:
  html:
    theme: cerulean
    highlight: tango
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 2
    toc-location: left
    code-fold: true
    embed-resources: true
execute:
  warning: false
  message: false
  echo: false
---

::: {.callout-note}
Make sure `scfaReporter` is installed and that the `scfa_dir` parameter points to
Chromeleon `.xls` exports while `manifest_path` points to the metadata workbook.
:::

```{r setup}
required_params <- c("project_id", "scfa_dir", "manifest_path")
missing <- required_params[vapply(required_params, function(x) {
  val <- params[[x]]
  is.null(val) || identical(val, "")
}, logical(1))]
if (length(missing) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required parameters: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
}

library(scfaReporter)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(kableExtra)
library(tidyr)

`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) y else x

aov_formula <- params$aov_formula
if (is.character(aov_formula) && nzchar(aov_formula)) {
  aov_formula <- stats::as.formula(aov_formula)
}

lmer_formula <- params$lmer_formula
if (is.character(lmer_formula) && nzchar(lmer_formula)) {
  lmer_formula <- stats::as.formula(lmer_formula)
}

pipeline <- scfaReporter::run_scfa_pipeline(
  scfa_dir = params$scfa_dir,
  manifest_path = params$manifest_path,
  analytes = params$analytes,
  normalization_multiplier = params$normalization_multiplier,
  normalization_basis = params$normalization_basis,
  stats = params$stats,
  lmer_formula = lmer_formula,
  aov_formula = aov_formula,
  x_col = params$x_col,
  facet_col = params$facet_col,
  y_label = params$y_label
)

normalized_data <- pipeline$normalized
summary_tbl <- pipeline$summary
plots <- pipeline$plots
models <- pipeline$models
scfa_long <- pipeline$long

group_levels <- levels(scfa_long$Group)
time_levels <- levels(scfa_long$Time)

description_lookup <- list(
  lmer = "Box-and-whisker plots display the data for each acid. For every SCFA we fitted a linear mixed-effects model with **Group** and **Time** main effects plus their interaction, along with subject-specific random intercepts. Post-hoc contrasts were obtained with the **emmeans** package.",
  anova = "Box-and-whisker plots display the data for each acid. Analysis of variance (ANOVA) was performed to assess statistical differences among variables, followed by Tukey's HSD pairwise comparisons.",
  none = "The per-sample short-chain fatty acid (SCFA) content is summarized below."
)
stat_description <- description_lookup[[params$stats]] %||% description_lookup$none
```

```{r export-data}
if (isTRUE(params$export_csv)) {
  message("Writing normalized concentrations to scfa_concentration_normalized.csv")
  utils::write.csv(
    normalized_data,
    file = "scfa_concentration_normalized.csv",
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

# Summary of SCFA data (`r params$y_label`)

This study evaluates `r params$sample_type` SCFA measurements for project `r params$project_id`.
Short-chain fatty acids were quantified using GC-FID and normalized to
`r params$y_label`.

## Summarised Statistics

```{r summary-table}
knitr::kable(
  summary_tbl,
  digits = c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2),
  col.names = c("SCFA", "Group", "Time", "Samples", "Subjects", "Mean", "SD", "SEM", "Min", "Max")
) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"))
```

## Statistical analysis

::: {.panel-tabset}
```{r stats}
if (params$stats == "lmer") {
  for (name in names(models)) {
    model_info <- models[[name]]
    cat("\n### ", name, "\n", sep = "")
    if (!is.null(model_info$anova) && nrow(model_info$anova) > 0) {
      cat("\n#### Fixed effects (Type III ANOVA)\n")
      knitr::kable(model_info$anova, digits = 3) %>%
        kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive")) %>%
        print()
    }
    if (!is.null(model_info$coefficients) && "Estimate" %in% colnames(model_info$coefficients)) {
      cat("\n#### Model coefficients\n")
      coef_view <- model_info$coefficients %>%
        dplyr::select(Term, Estimate, `Std. Error`, df, `t value`, `Pr(>|t|)`) %>%
        dplyr::rename(`p value` = `Pr(>|t|)`)
      knitr::kable(coef_view, digits = 3) %>%
        kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive")) %>%
        print()
    }
    if (!is.null(model_info$group_contrasts)) {
      cat("\n#### Group contrasts (Tukey-adjusted)\n")
      knitr::kable(model_info$group_contrasts, digits = 3) %>%
        kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive")) %>%
        print()
    }
    if (!is.null(model_info$time_contrasts)) {
      cat("\n#### Time contrasts (Tukey-adjusted)\n")
      knitr::kable(model_info$time_contrasts, digits = 3) %>%
        kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive")) %>%
        print()
    }
  }
} else if (params$stats == "anova") {
  for (name in names(models)) {
    model_info <- models[[name]]
    if (is.null(model_info$aov)) next
    cat("\n### ", name, "\n", sep = "")
    knitr::kable(model_info$aov, digits = 3) %>%
      kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive")) %>%
      print()
    if (!is.null(model_info$tukey)) {
      cat("\n#### Tukey HSD\n")
      tukey_df <- model_info$tukey[[1]]
      knitr::kable(tukey_df, digits = 3) %>%
        kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive")) %>%
        print()
    }
  }
} else {
  cat("Statistical modeling was disabled (params$stats = 'none').")
}
```
:::

# Methods

```{r methods}
method <- list()
method[["mouse_feces"]] <- "The procedure for SCFA extraction follows the protocol described by Zhao et al. [-@zhao2006rapid]. Mouse fecal pellets were resuspended in MilliQ-grade water and homogenized using an MP Bio FastPrep system for 1 minute at 4.0 m/s. The suspensions were acidified to a final pH of 2.0 using 5M HCl. After acidification, the suspensions were incubated and centrifuged at 10,000 RPM to separate the supernatant. The resulting supernatant was spiked with 2-ethylbutyric acid to achieve a final concentration of 1 mM."
method[["human_feces"]] <- "The procedure for SCFA extraction follows the protocol described by Zhao et al. [-@zhao2006rapid]. Human fecal samples were resuspended in MilliQ-grade water and homogenized using an MP Bio FastPrep system for 1 minute at 4.0 m/s. The suspensions were acidified to a final pH of 2.0 using 5M HCl. After acidification, the suspensions were incubated and centrifuged at 10,000 RPM to separate the supernatant. The resulting supernatant was spiked with 2-ethylbutyric acid to achieve a final concentration of 1 mM."
method[["feces"]] <- method[["human_feces"]]
method[["other"]] <- "The procedure for SCFA extraction is based on the protocol described by Zhao et al. [-@zhao2006rapid]. The material was resuspended in MilliQ-grade water and homogenized using an MP Bio FastPrep system for 1 minute at 4.0 m/s. The suspensions were acidified to a final pH of 2.0 using 5M HCl. After acidification, the suspensions were incubated and centrifuged at 10,000 RPM to separate the supernatant. The resulting supernatant was spiked with 2-ethylbutyric acid to achieve a final concentration of 1 mM."
```

`r method[[params$sample_type]] %||% method[["other"]]`
